'''Artom's Wings''' was an award issued by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to serving members of the Militia who demonstrated bravery. The medal could be awarded only to recipients previously decorated with the bravery award [[Artom's Cluster]].<ref name="Lockdown on Soboll" />
